brief.zh: 用叶子猛烈地拍击僵尸

description.en: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves. Hurls and regrow its leaves when powered by other Shadow plants.
description.zh: 暗影龙葵是一种暗影植物，能用叶子猛烈地拍击僵尸。当其他暗影植物为其提供能量时，它的叶子会喷射并重新生长。

chat.en: For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
chat.zh: 对暗影龙葵来说，扇耳光是一份义务，也是一种特权。他的家族有三位国王、四位大使和一位总统，他们都曾以到处扇别人耳光为荣。

text.en: hurls and regrows leaves when powered
text.zh: 得到暗影能量时能重新长出叶片，并远程抛出
